issues.evidence: At 71.5 s Maya lowers the laptop lid; the timeline explicitly states 'No foley on ... the laptop close.'
issues.suggested_action: Add a quiet hinge movement followed by a firm lid contact, synchronized to the actual closure.

issues.evidence: Measured cuts_on_sound_pct is 45%; 11 cuts lack sound events: 11.2, 13.7, 16.7, 19.7, 22.2, 28.2, 36.2, 42.2, 48.7, 51.2 and 73.2 s.
issues.suggested_action: Spot these cuts with restrained action transients, UI ticks or existing score accents; prioritize the manual-work cuts and the review-panel arrival.

issues.evidence: The review sequence shows 'Changes ready for review' followed by '10 of 10 changes accepted'; the only specified product interaction sound is 'UI click at Accept all ~61.1.'
issues.suggested_action: Give the actual Accept all press a precise click and the completed state a short, distinctive confirmation tone from the same UI sound family.

issues.evidence: The flagged-number message occupies the punch beat; measured digital_silence_windows_s includes 26.0, 26.5, 27.0 and 27.5, with the 26 s section at -180 dBFS.
issues.suggested_action: Keep the score stop but carry a faint office ambience through the message and reaction so the pause retains physical presence.

issues.evidence: At 12.2 s Maya's hand meets the paper stack beside the laptop; the timeline explicitly lists no paper foley.
issues.suggested_action: Add a close, dry paper brush or shuffle at the hand contact; verify motion before adding any page-turn sound.

issues.evidence: The frames show chat cards, a selected spreadsheet cell, pasted memo text, slide changes, highlighted diff rows and a completed review state; specified cues are only keyboard at 13.85, mouse click at 16.75 and Accept all click around 61.1.
issues.suggested_action: Use one restrained UI family for card arrivals, selections, paste and diff navigation, reserving the clearest confirmation sound for acceptance.

issues.evidence: Keyboard starts at 13.85 s after the 13.7 s cut, mouse click is at 16.75 s after the 16.7 s cut, and acceptance is specified only as '~61.1'; sampled frames do not establish the exact contact frames.
issues.suggested_action: Verify each cue against the moving recording and align it to the keystroke, mouse-down or state change, rather than moving it automatically to the cut.

constraint_failures.rule: No more than 50% of cuts may lack a sound event in a film that claims urgency.
